messages:
Oliver S: Quick follow-up from the rate-limiter RFC — we still haven't nailed the ownership boundary for probe detection vs quota enforcement. My take: edge sidecar should flag high-entropy probe attempts and tag requests, but central quota enforcer should do final probation/eviction decisions.
Tara L: agree with separation. sidecar is closest to traffic, so it can catch quick bursts and fingerprint reuse. central enforcer needs stable signals to avoid oscillating penalties.
Mike H: Concern: if sidecar just tags and central trusts it blindly, we open a spoof vector. Need signed attestations or short-lived tokens from edge to central.
Anya R: +1. Suggestion: sidecar signs a compact attestation blob with HMAC key rotated per-edge. central validates before applying probation. If attestation missing, central falls back to conservative heuristics.
Priya K: Also think about signal aging. Right now central stores raw probe counts and they stay visible for hours — that penalizes benign bursts. Propose exponential decay with half-life parameter per-tenant.
Oliver S: Nice. Example config sketch: ```
edge.sidecar:
  probe_window_sec: 20
  entropy_threshold: 0.65
  sign_attestations: true
central.enforcer:
  probation_grace_sec: 90
  attestation_hmac_key_id: "edge-1"
  signal_decay_half_life_sec: 900
```
Tara L: We should also define the wire contract: attestation = {client_fp, probe_score, ts, edge_id} + HMAC. Keep it small (<= 256 bytes) so we don't add latency to hot paths.
Mike H: Ops question — where do keys live? If edge keys are compromised, attacker can fake attestations. Maybe use short-lived mTLS between edge and central and only permit attestation endpoints from registered edges.
Anya R: mTLS + HMAC rotation seems reasonable. For private deployments, customers may want to manage their own attestation keys — make that pluggable. Document the API surface clearly.
Priya K: On the fairness side: when central moves a tenant into probation, how do we reflect that in routing? Immediate demotion to cheaper model? or soft token rate cap? My vote: soft cap + priority score so downstream schedulers can gracefully reduce throughput.
Oliver S: That aligns with the degrade-first principle. Soft cap with a decaying priority multiplier. Also log a deterministic event so customer support can replay why a tenant was probed.
Tara L: Telemetry: add probe-origin sampling (edge id, route, client_fp hash) and a compact histogram of probe scores. Avoid storing raw client_fp values.
Mike H: Quick test plan idea: synthetic adversarial probe generator that mimics multi-edge distributed probing. Run against staging with attestation and key-rotation enabled. We'll verify false positive/negative curves.
Anya R: +1. Also run chaos injection where attestations are missing to ensure central falls back safely.
deploy-bot: Deployed attestation schema v1 to staging at 1729877000 :sparkles:
Priya K: Action items: 1) Mike to prototype HMAC attestation handshake (this week). 2) Tara to write minimal wire spec and privacy constraints. 3) Anya to propose key rotation and private-deploy pluggable model. 4) Oliver to add probation/soft-cap RFC appendix.
Oliver S: Thanks all — aim to sync next Tue to finalize interfaces. If anyone wants to push a draft before then, drop it in #eng-platform and ping me. :thumbsup:
